title: FounderGate Pre-Push Checker Event
description: A single lifecycle event emitted by the independent pre-push CHECKER as it reviews a clean worktree. Events form an append-only, read-only trace (the checker never mutates the repo — it only narrates what it observed). Events are evidence, not authorization. CHECKER SCAFFOLD ONLY — a checker cannot self-certify and never edits code.

event_type.description: Lifecycle stage. checker_started = review began; worktree_probed = clean/dirty status observed (read-only); baseline_resolved = diff baseline pinned; finding_emitted = one finding recorded; report_emitted = final report produced; checker_declined = the checker abstained/blocked (out of competence, conflict of interest, unreadable state).

target_sha.description: Head SHA under review at the time of the event. 7-40 lowercase hex.

mutation_free.description: Optional explicit self-account: this event caused zero repo mutation. When present it MUST be true — an event that mutated the repo is not a checker event.
